question: In how many assembly constituencies were the Delhi Assembly elections held on 5 February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**70**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Delhi Legislative Assembly** consists of **70 assembly constituencies**, which represent the elected members of the state legislature.
 
• The **Delhi Assembly elections** are conducted across these **70 constituencies**, where eligible voters elect their representatives.
 
• The **elections held on 5 February 2025** followed the same pattern as previous elections, with voting organized in all **70 constituencies.**
 
• The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** is responsible for overseeing the elections in Delhi, ensuring a fair and transparent process in all constituencies.
 
• The number **70** has remained constant since the formation of the **Delhi Legislative Assembly** under the provisions of the **Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi Act, 1991**. *Hence, the correct answer is 70.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Delhi Legislative Assembly:**

 
 
• The **Delhi Legislative Assembly** was established in **1993** under the provisions of the **Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi Act, 1991**.
 
• It is a unicameral legislature, consisting of **70 members**, each elected from a single-member constituency.
 
• The Assembly is responsible for making laws on subjects listed in the **State List** and **Concurrent List** except for land, police, and public order.
 
 
 
• **Delhi Assembly Elections:**
 
 
• Elections for the Delhi Legislative Assembly are held every **five years**, unless the assembly is dissolved earlier.
 
• The elections are conducted under the supervision of the **Election Commission of India**, which ensures free and fair voting.
 
• The elected members of the assembly represent their respective **70 constituencies** and are responsible for governance and legislation in the National Capital Territory of Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi Act, 1991:**
 
 
• This act provided for the creation of the **Delhi Legislative Assembly**, granting Delhi a partial statehood status.
 
• Under this act, Delhi has powers similar to those of a state, except in matters of **land, police, and public order**, which remain under the control of the central government.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Structure of Assembly Constituencies:**

 
 
• Each of the **70 constituencies** represents a geographical area, ensuring proportional representation of the population.
 
• Constituencies are delineated based on guidelines set by the **Delimitation Commission**, ensuring fair distribution of voters.
 
 
 
• **Role of Election Commission:**
 
 
• The **Election Commission of India** oversees all elections in Delhi, ensuring adherence to democratic principles and electoral laws.
 
• The commission ensures that elections in all **70 constituencies** are conducted in a transparent and unbiased manner.
 
 
 
• **Historical Insights:**
 
 
• The **first Delhi Assembly elections** were held in **1993**, following the establishment of the legislative assembly under the 1991 Act.
 
• The number of constituencies has remained at **70** since its inception.
